description: NexaMusic 0.1.0 beta — the first NexaMusic-branded beta build.

changelog.title: NexaMusic Beta
items: About screen credits Smelokuhle (Mahungela) as the developer.
Community links now point to the NexaMusic GitHub repository and Discord.
Support options are marked Not available while support channels are being prepared.
Software update and changelog screens now use the NexaMusic repository.
Crash and playback issue reports are directed to the NexaMusic issue tracker.
